name.description: Display name for the API key

prefix.description: Prefix of the full key, shown for display purposes

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the key

bound_tools.description: BoundTools are the tools the prompt is allowed to call.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the version was created.

created_by.description: CreatedBy is the actor who created the version.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier of the version.

status.description: Status is the lifecycle status of the version (draft|production).

system_prompt.description: SystemPrompt is the full system prompt text.

template_id.description: TemplateID is the template this version belongs to.

variables.description: Variables are the template variables used by the prompt.

version.description: Version is the version number, incrementing within a template.
